item.text: CAS-LSTM addresses conventional stacked LSTMs' inability to fully benefit from gating in layer-to-layer connections by using cell states to control vertical information flow.
triple: layer-to-layer connections cannot fully benefit from the carefully constructed gating mechanism used in temporal transitions

item.text: The proposed architecture called CAS-LSTM is evaluated on SNLI, MultiNLI, Quora Question Pairs, and SST, where CAS-LSTMs consistently outperform typical stacked LSTMs.
triple: typical stacked LSTMs on SNLI, MultiNLI, Quora Question Pairs, and SST

item.text: The direct connection between INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 in CAS-LSTM is argued to help and stabilize training because terminal error signals can be easily backpropagated to model parameters.
